title: Full faithfulness descends through coherent common-stage representatives
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and separated finite-type schemes $Z,X$ over a field $k$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each finite subextension $E\subset\Omega$ use the raw rationalized categories $\mathcal C_E(W)=D^b_c(W,E)$ for $W=Z,X$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. For $E\subset L$ let $T^W_{L/E}$ be their scalar extension, with normalized identity transitions and the associators $a^W_{M,L,E}$ of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Form the literal common-stage pair categories $\mathcal C_\Omega(W)$ of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]: objects are $(E,P)$, and a morphism from $(E,P)$ to $(E',Q)$ is a class $[L,u]$ with $L\supset E,E'$ and $u:T^W_{L/E}P\to T^W_{L/E'}Q$, two representatives being equal exactly when their scalar transports agree at a larger common finite extension.

Suppose given fully faithful functors $\Phi_E:\mathcal C_E(Z)\to\mathcal C_E(X)$ and natural isomorphisms
$$\theta_{L/E}:\Phi_LT^Z_{L/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}T^X_{L/E}\Phi_E$$
normalized to the identity for $L=E$ and satisfying
$$a^X\circ T^X_{M/L}(\theta_{L/E})\circ\theta_{M/L,T^Z_{L/E}P}
=\theta_{M/E,P}\circ\Phi_M(a^Z_P)\qquad(E\subset L\subset M).$$
Then the formulas
$$\Phi(E,P)=(E,\Phi_EP),\qquad
\Phi[L,u]=[L,\theta_{L/E',Q}\circ\Phi_L(u)\circ\theta_{L/E,P}^{-1}]$$
define a fully faithful functor $\Phi:\mathcal C_\Omega(Z)\to\mathcal C_\Omega(X)$. More precisely, put $b_L(u)=\theta_{L/E',Q}\Phi_L(u)\theta_{L/E,P}^{-1}$. For every pair $(E,P),(E',Q)$ the inverse of the induced Hom map sends $[L,v]$ to $[L,b_L^{-1}(v)]$; this formula is independent of the representative and of enlarging $L$. No essential-surjectivity hypothesis on $\Phi_E$, no fully faithful hypothesis on scalar extension, and no Karoubi completion is imposed.

proof.text: For arbitrary stage systems, conjugating F.mapAt(u) by the inverse beta at the source and beta at the target recovers Phi_L.map(u). Faithfulness of Phi_L therefore proves injectivity of F.mapAt. For any target arrow v, apply the finite-stage preimage to beta_source inverse followed by v followed by beta_target. Applying F.mapAt to this arrow gives v by the finite map-preimage equation and cancellation of beta components. These calculations are sfMapAt_injective and sfMapAt_preimage, proved private helpers in the item module.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: bijections at a common finite stage

proof.text: The source-library theorem StageSystem.Morphism.tr_mapAt already proves that the representative map commutes with every scalar transport: T.tr h (F.mapAt u) = F.mapAt (S.tr h u). Its proof expands exactly the assumed coherence and naturality calculation of the original plan. Reuse this theorem rather than repeating that calculation.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: scalar-extension compatibility, expanded using the coherence hypothesis

proof.text: The existing StageSystem.Morphism.functor is the descended pair functor. Its functor_obj and functor_map_mkHom equations give precisely the literal pair and forward representative formulas in the conclusion. Its construction already proves independence of forward representatives and preservation of identities and composition. The extra unit-normalization assumption is not needed for these equations: conjugation preserves identity arrows directly.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: independence of the forward representative

proof.text: Prove faithfulness of the pair functor (sfPairFaithful). Induct on representatives of two source arrows. If their images agree, the quotient equality criterion mkHom_eq_mkHom_iff' from [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] supplies a larger common stage at which the transported images agree. Rewrite both transports with tr_mapAt, and apply sfMapAt_injective at that stage. The same quotient equality criterion then gives equality of the original source classes. This uses no faithfulness of a scalar transition.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: identities and composition on common-stage representatives

proof.text: Prove fullness of the pair functor (sfPairFull). Induct on a target representative [L,v] using hom_induction from [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. The arrow [L, Phi_L.preimage(beta_source inverse followed by v followed by beta_target)] is a preimage: functor_map_mkHom and sfMapAt_preimage compute its image as [L,v]. Thus the descended Hom map is surjective without first choosing an inverse on quotient representatives.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: explicit inverse descends to equivalence classes

proof.text: The full and faithful pair functor has the standard FullyFaithful structure h. For every target representative [L,v], apply h.map_injective to the desired preimage equation. The left side maps to [L,v] by h.map_preimage, and the right side maps to [L,v] by functor_map_mkHom and sfMapAt_preimage. This proves the exact inverse formula for every representative and every enlargement at once; independence follows because each formula equals the same h.preimage. Combine with the object and forward-map equations from step 3. No new public statement or unproved helper is introduced.

source.place: Algebraically closed-stage paragraph: mutual inverse Hom maps and full faithfulness

lean.statement: theorem sfCommonStageFullFaithfulness (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (k : Type u) [Field k] (_hl : IsUnit (l : k)) (Z X : Scheme.{u}) (z : Z ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated z] [LocallyOfFiniteType z] [QuasiCompact z] [IsSeparated x] [LocallyOfFiniteType x] [QuasiCompact x] (F : StageSystem.Morphism (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω Z) (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X)) (hΦ : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω, (F.Φ E).FullyFaithful) (_hunit : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (P : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω Z E), HEq ((F.β (le_refl E)).hom.app P) ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor l Ω X E).hom.app ((F.Φ E).obj P) ≫ (F.Φ E).map ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.unitor l Ω Z E).inv.app P))) : ∃ h : F.functor.FullyFaithful, (∀ A : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Z, F.functor.obj A = ⟨A.stage, (F.Φ A.stage).obj A.obj⟩) ∧ (∀ (A B : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Z) (L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (hA : A.stage ≤ L) (hB : B.stage ≤ L) (u : A.toStage hA ⟶ B.toStage hB), F.functor.map (StageSystem.PairCategory.mkHom L hA hB u) = StageSystem.PairCategory.mkHom (X := F.functor.obj A) (Y := F.functor.obj B) L hA hB ((F.β hA).hom.app A.obj ≫ (F.Φ L).map u ≫ (F.β hB).inv.app B.obj)) ∧ (∀ (A B : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Z) (L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (hA : A.stage ≤ L) (hB : B.stage ≤ L) (v : (F.functor.obj A).toStage hA ⟶ (F.functor.obj B).toStage hB), h.preimage (StageSystem.PairCategory.mkHom L hA hB v) = StageSystem.PairCategory.mkHom L hA hB ((hΦ L).preimage ((F.β hA).inv.app A.obj ≫ v ≫ (F.β hB).hom.app B.obj)))
